positions.name: KnowledgeRecordOverride
positions.frame: What authority does the speaker claim to determine what the knowledge record must retain or discard?
positions.why: All three expressions enact the speaker's authority over the knowledge record — two as imperative commands to forget and remove specific information about the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration, one as a declarative correction asserting the observatory never calibrated it. The conviction gradient between the directives (decision) and the assertion (claim) is internal tension the frame holds: the speaker both commands erasure and asserts the corrected fact, exercising the same epistemic authority in different modes.
